name: Recruit Growth
description: Shows how many recruits each settlement gains per day and why, when growth is paused, and when the next recruits from Britain arrive. Hover a settlement's recruits number for a summary, click it for details; click the population number in the top bar for all settlements. British campaigns also get a colonial recruits total on the top bar (click it for the per-town list). Read-only: changes nothing in the game.
author: UGAR modding project
